assets.ti: NRC UFO file UAR/N/116-125 (1967), including Shag Harbour, Nova Scotia
assets.region: Lower Woods Harbour (Shag Harbour), Nova Scotia
assets.de: The National Research Council of Canada's file of non-meteoric sighting reports UAR/N/116-125, including the reports on the object seen to descend toward the sea off Lower Woods Harbour (Shag Harbour), Nova Scotia, on 4 October 1967. 35 pages. Herzberg Institute of Astrophysics – Reports on non-meteoric sightings, unidentified flying objects, UFO's. National Research Council of Canada, file UAR/N/116-125. Library and Archives Canada, RG77, R1207-31-X-E (MIKAN 134925).
